# Headstone: a round-topped slab 0.6 wide, 0.26 thick (thickened: 1.7 splats), 0.95 tall, leaning back 8 degrees. Up Z, front -Y.
new
add mesh cube --name Slab --size 1 --location 0 0 0.35
scale 0.6 0.26 0.7
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name Crown --vertices 8 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0.7 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material new Stone --base-color 0.776 0.718 0.745
select Slab Crown
material assign Stone
active Slab
join
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
set rotation 8 0 0
apply --rotation
shade flat
export headstone.glb
